name: Big Thunder Mountain
description: A classic Wild West mine train roller coaster thundering through red rock canyons and flooded mines at 60 km/h. One of Disneyland Paris's most iconic and beloved attractions.

name: Pirates of the Caribbean
description: An epic boat dark ride through a spectacular Caribbean port under siege by pirates. The most elaborate version of this classic anywhere in the world with stunning sets and Audio-Animatronics.

name: Phantom Manor
description: A uniquely dark and story-rich haunted mansion experience exclusive to Disneyland Paris. Guests board Doom Buggies through 999 ghostly inhabitants in a gothic Victorian manor with a tragic backstory.

name: Star Wars Hyperspace Mountain
description: An exhilarating indoor space roller coaster re-themed to Star Wars with X-wings, TIE fighters and a thrilling battle through hyperspace at 57 km/h with two inversions in complete darkness.

name: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Peril
description: A thrilling outdoor roller coaster looping through ancient jungle ruins on a mine cart. The only inverting roller coaster in Disneyland Park with a full 360-degree loop.

name: Buzz Lightyear Laser Blast
description: An interactive dark ride where guests join the Space Ranger Academy, spinning their vehicle and firing laser cannons at Emperor Zurg's robots to earn the highest score.

name: It's a Small World
description: A classic gentle boat ride through colourful scenes of singing children from cultures around the world. The most beloved family attraction at Disneyland Paris with its unforgettable theme song.

name: The Twilight Zone Tower of Terror
description: A thrilling drop tower inside the haunted Hollywood Tower Hotel. Guests enter the Twilight Zone before plunging in a free-falling elevator at terrifying speed in one of Disney's greatest attractions.

name: Frozen Ever After
description: A brand new magical boat ride through the Kingdom of Arendelle opened March 2026. Journey through iconic scenes from Frozen with state-of-the-art Audio-Animatronics and stunning projection technology.

name: Crush's Coaster
description: A thrilling spinning roller coaster through the ocean world of Finding Nemo. Riders spin freely in turtle shells through underwater tunnels and exciting drops at 70 km/h.

name: Ratatouille: The Adventure
description: A unique trackless dark ride shrinking guests to the size of Remy the rat as they scurry through Gusteau's restaurant. Freshly renovated in 2026 with enhanced scenes and new Parisian studio queue.

name: Avengers Assemble: Flight Force
description: A high-speed launched roller coaster themed to the Avengers reaching extreme speeds with multiple launches and inversions through the Marvel Avengers Campus.

name: Raiponce Tangled Spin
description: A brand new family spinner opened March 2026 where guests board gondolas spinning beneath a sky filled with glowing lanterns while I See the Light plays. Voiced by Mandy Moore exclusively for Disneyland Paris.
